recentItems.title: KKCO/KJCT The Ten Open - 9/9/2026 (Scripps Keeper Look Launch)
recentItems.description:

News open to The Ten (10pm), the news program that airs on KKCO and KJCT as a simulcast, recorded on Wednesday, September 9, 2026. KKCO/KJCT are both owned by the E.W. Scripps Company and serve the Grand Junction, CO area. KKCO is NBC affiliate based, while KJCT is an ABC affiliate. 

On the "Midday Live" (12pm) newscast of both KKCO/KJCT of this recording date of September 9, 2026, KKCO/KJCT made the surprise debut of their new "Scripps Keeper" look and elements onto their newscast. The graphics are designed by Defiant LA, music called "Scripps Newscast" by 11/One Music. The voiceover artist was kept at the station, using Eric Gordon, opting for local control. 

This big launch all comes from when KKCO/KJCT was since purchased by E.W. Scripps earlier within the year, making a big company switch for KKCO/KJCT from Gray over to Scripps as part of a trade deal that was made between Gray and Scripps to trade off and gain stations for their own companies' benefits for how these TV stations will be owned and maintained by for the best results.

This launch also comes with the company rolling out a new visual look with these "Scripps Keeper" graphical elements, musical sound design, etc.

recentItems.description:
This channel is a proud official sponsor partner with one of the largest community media broadcasting industry/enthusiast related servers called Broadcast Plaza: https://discord.com/invite/zYwZPAgFDN

News open and short snippet of the A-block segment of the all new 3 p.m. newscast edition of WTVF News Channel 5, recorded on Tuesday, September 8, 2026. WTVF is the CBS affiliate and Scripps owned TV station serving the Nashville, TN area.

This is the very first newscast on this recording day that WTVF debuted their brand new 3 p.m. newscast. 

This newscast was developed all coming down to syndication changes that are happening in the TV lineup (which usually happens around this time in September, so it's typical). It's also a fact within syndication lineups that "The Kelly Clarkson Show" would be ending its run, leaving in a big opportunity for where stations who choose to fill up their programming that they can opt to add in a new newscast or some other kind of program. WTVF decided to choose to add in a new 3 p.m. newscast, which lasts about an hour every weekday from Monday to Friday. 

WTVF opted in for more news in order to compete with other TV stations across Nashville, TN along with the entire TV landscape competition, too. 

Graphics used are the "Scripps Keeper" look done by Defiant LA. Music used is "Scripps Newscast" composed by 11/One Music, which is based out of Nashville, TN. Voiceover is done by an unknown guy.
